scope: One synthetic fundamentals metric per company, period, source and delivery vintage; not a universal fundamentals schema.

owners.support: Resolve Data Operations service record before activation

bindings.publication: Stage the batch, validate it, append immutable vintages and atomically accept its delivery in the publication ledger. Governed views include all accepted deliveries, preserving prior history.

semantics.grain: Entity × metric × fiscal period end × source × vintage

time.published_at: Source publication time with retained provenance
time.available_at: First accepted, permitted platform availability of this vintage

semantics.corrections: Append a new vintage and dataset_version with its actual availability. Preserve original rows and earlier publication snapshots.
semantics.researchSelection: For each business key/source, choose the most recent accepted vintage whose available_at is at or before decision_time; preserve source selection policy and current access checks.

quality.onFailure: Retain raw delivery; hold the new dataset_version and keep the last accepted version explicitly labelled with its freshness. Do not silently publish partial or restated data.

params.missingPublicationTime: Hold pending explicit domain policy; never invent knowledge time

params.expected: Vendor delivery manifest plus contracted universe/calendar

params.policy: Enforced in access layer and replay-tested research joins

service.activationGate: Approve expected calendar/universe, tolerances, actual owners, SLOs, entitlements, vintages and publication recovery before activation.

consumers.acceptance: Decision at 09:04 excludes the 09:06 vintage; historical replay retains the original value after a later correction.
